title: Time Series Foundation Models on the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2611.30404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast zero-shot with accuracy exceeding that of task-specific models, and the smaller ones fit on edge devices. Operational deployments must refresh their forecast as new observations arrive, and privacy and latency requirements often force this refresh onto resource-constrained edge devices. To serve as a forecasting system there, a TSFM must refresh quickly, keep latency and peak memory bounded as the stream grows, and retain its accuracy as the observed history accumulates. Refreshing incrementally without altering the forecast requires temporal causality: non-causal models recompute at every update, causal attention admits a KV cache that grows linearly, and causal recurrent models update a fixed-size state in constant time and memory. We make these states persist across refreshes for every causal architecture and verify equivalence to full recomputation. We evaluate nine TSFM configurations o

translated_title: 边缘设备上的时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）能够进行零样本预测，其准确度超过特定任务模型，且较小的模型可以部署在边缘设备上。在实际运行部署中，必须随着新观测数据的到来不断刷新预测，而隐私和延迟要求通常迫使这一刷新过程在资源受限的边缘设备上进行。要在此环境中作为预测系统服务，时间序列基础模型必须能够快速刷新，随着数据流的增长保持延迟和峰值内存有界，并在观测历史不断积累时保持其准确性。在不改变预测结果的前提下进行增量刷新需要时间因果性：非因果模型在每次更新时都需要重新计算，因果注意力机制允许使用线性增长的KV缓存，而因果循环模型则以恒定的时间和内存更新固定大小的状态。我们使这些状态在每次刷新之间持久保存，适用于所有因果架构，并验证了其与完整重新计算的等价性。我们评估了九种时间序列基础模型配置。
tldr: 该论文针对边缘设备上的时间序列基础模型，提出使因果模型的状态在刷新之间持久化保存，从而以恒定的时间和内存实现增量预测刷新，并验证了其与完整重新计算的等价性，适用于所有因果架构。
en_tdlr: This paper enables time series foundation models deployed on edge devices to persist causal states across refreshes, achieving incremental forecasting with constant time and memory per update, verified to be equivalent to full recomputation across all causal architectures.
